name: Hirohara D Rudman
original_name: 広原　D　ルドマン三世
source: [url=https://vndb.org/c43443]Celica's[/url] father. A wealthy eccentric man who has kept his daughter locked up in her home since she was a child. He wants Touma to marry his daughter and sets up a trial for him to pass. However when [url=https://vndb.org/c42884]Madoka[/url] runs off crying after their meeting he realizes she was in love with Touma as well and Touma's engagement to his daughter would hurt her. So he gives Touma 3 days to decide whom to marry, Cecilia, Madoka, or even Touma's own sister Sakura. Whomever Touma chooses Rudman promises to make it happen.
